readme.text:
This is Pokeclicker for [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg/). It is not a standalone game and must be connected to an AP server to make progress.

The web client is located at:
https://hallstead.github.io/AP-Pokeclicker/

The desktop client is located at:
https://github.com/Hallstead/Pokeclicker-desktop/releases/latest

To connect to the server:
- Enter your host address, port, and slot name (and password if you have one).
- Then click the "Connect (Archipelago)" button.

notes.text:
A bunch of small improvements in this update. Wanderers are now optional and underground and safari now have starting levels.

**Updates included:**
Early Town Map
Starting Safari Level
Starting Underground Level
Wanderer Appearance Multiplier, Catch Rate
Wanderers Logic now optional.
Filler Items are now randomly generated
Fight Ash Ketchum Kanto and Bill's Grandpa added as locations
Various Client Updates

**Bug Fixes:**
Capture Santa Jynx was missing Town Map requirement
Spooky Bulbasaur line had the wrong name for Seasonal Events category
